summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K to report a routine local-market bond placement in Chile. The bank issued senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds (Serie FT) under CMF registration 11/2022, totaling UF 1,100,000, maturing October 1, 2032, at an average placement rate of 2.92%. This is a standard debt offering by the issuer, not a special situation. No strategic event, change of control, or restructuring is involved. What to watch: continuing debt management and refinancing activity by the bank.
